optionalManifestBundles.label: Background location tracking
optionalManifestBundles.warning: Requesting ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION and the location foreground-service permissions triggers Play Console policy review — Google requires a clear, prominent in-app disclosure and justification before you can publish.
optionalManifestBundles.nextSteps: Pass a `foregroundService` option to `startLocationUpdatesAsync` (notification title/body) so the OS keeps tracking alive outside the app. expo-location's own LocationTaskService is already declared in its AndroidManifest.xml and merges automatically — this only adds the permissions it needs.

infoPlistKeys.NSMotionUsageDescription: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to detect your current motion activity.

reviewedNonIntrospectableMods.note: withForegroundServiceIcon's dangerous half runs unconditionally with icon:null by default (expo-location's withLocation.js: `withForegroundServiceIcon(config, { icon: androidForegroundServiceIcon ?? null })`) — with icon:null it only unlinks a previously-written foreground-service icon PNG if one exists (existsSync-gated in removeForegroundServiceIconImageFiles). No-op for every consumer: this repo never sets androidForegroundServiceIcon anywhere.
